sources.title: Parable - Fine-Tuned Qwen3 & Granite Local LLMs for Agent Tasks
sources.snippet: Parable: small local LLMs (Qwen3 4B/8B, Granite 4.1 3B/8B) fine-tuned on genuine Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.5 agent traces. GGUF for Ollama and LM Studio, honest evals, published corpus.

sources.title: parable/README.md at main · ankit-aglawe/parable · GitHub
sources.snippet: What is in this repository training/ QLoRA training kernels, one per model. Completion-only loss masking, mixed-domain replay, checkpoint relay to Hugging Face every save so a run survives session caps and moves across GPUs. corpus/ Trace ingestion, session reconstruction, secret scrubbing, fuzzy train/test decontamination. The resulting 10.6k-row corpus: AnkitAI/parable-corpus-v2 eval ...
